description: This Java source file defines the class CertificateServices, which provides methods for importing issuer certificates into a keystore, handling certificate data, and managing related provisioning information within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class specifically includes an importIssuerCertificate method that loads a keystore, processes a PEM-encoded certificate, stores it, and optionally records issuer details in the database.

classes.name: CertificateServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services related to certificate management, including importing issuer certificates and maintaining keystore entries.

methods.name: importIssuerCertificate
methods.description: Imports a certificate into the keystore, updates the keystore file, and optionally records issuer details in the database. Handles PEM-to-certificate conversion, keystore manipulation, and exception handling.
